machine=imx8mp-evk
# Kernel, dtb and initramfs travel as one FIT (avocado-imx-fitimage.bb) so a
# single signature covers all three under verified-boot. The default
# configuration boots imx8mp-evk-pcie-8997.dtb (FIT_CONF_DEFAULT_DTB in
# avocado-imx8mp-evk.conf); a board with an SDIO M.2 module selects NXP's
# default dtb with `setenv avocado_boot 'bootm ${image_addr}#conf-imx8mp-evk.dtb'`.
image_file=fitImage

console=ttymxc1,115200
devtype=mmc
devnum=1
mmcblk=1
bootpart=3
rootdev=/dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p5

# Load the FIT well clear of where its own kernel decompresses to. The kernel
# subimage carries Load Address 0x40480000 (UBOOT_ENTRYPOINT:mx8m-generic-bsp)
# and bootm inflates the gzipped payload straight there; 0x80200000 is 1 GiB
# above that in a contiguous bank, so source and destination cannot overlap
# (the failure mode imx93-frdm hit at its old address). The initramfs stays
# inside the FIT - bootm reads ramdisk-1 in place - so no separate load address.
image_addr=0x80200000

# Slot A/B only: no recovery partition. An unset or invalid slot boots A.
avocado_boot_init=\
  if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
    echo "Booting B";\
    setenv bootpart 4;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p6;\
    setenv roothashdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p8;\
  else\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" != "a"; then\
      echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} unset or invalid";\
    fi;\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv bootpart 3;\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p5;\
    setenv roothashdev /dev/mmcblk${mmcblk}p7;\
  fi;\
  setenv bootargs audit=0 console=${console} root=${rootdev} rootwait;

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${image_addr} ${image_file}

# rootfs dm-verity. The root hash travels inside the FIT (property
# avocado,roothash on the default configuration node, put there by the runtime
# build), so it is covered by the FIT signature when one is enforced. Read it
# back after the load and hand it to systemd-veritysetup-generator in the
# initramfs: root moves to /dev/mapper/root over rootdev, hash tree from the
# slot's hash partition. A FIT without the property boots the rootfs directly,
# exactly as before.
avocado_verity_init=\
  if fdt addr ${image_addr}; then\
    if fdt get value fitconf /configurations default; then\
      if fdt get value roothash /configurations/${fitconf} avocado,roothash; then\
        echo "rootfs dm-verity root hash ${roothash}";\
        setenv bootargs audit=0 console=${console} root=/dev/mapper/root roothash=${roothash} systemd.verity_root_data=${rootdev} systemd.verity_root_hash=${roothashdev} rootwait;\
      fi;\
    fi;\
  fi;

avocado_boot=bootm ${image_addr};

bootcmd=run avocado_boot_init load_image avocado_verity_init avocado_boot
